WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 6
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 72 AND 81
),
store_sales_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
),
web_sales_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
),
catalog_sales_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN filtered_date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
),
web_or_catalog_qualified AS (
  SELECT customer_sk FROM web_sales_qualified
  UNION
  SELECT customer_sk FROM catalog_sales_qualified
)
SELECT
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
  cd_credit_rating,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt3,
  cd_dep_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt4,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt5,
  cd_dep_college_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt6
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  AND ca.ca_county IN ('Baldwin County', 'Cocke County', 'Elko County', 'Geauga County', 'Marengo County')
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('U', 'S')
  AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('Advanced Degree', 'Primary')
  AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
JOIN store_sales_qualified ss_qual ON c.c_customer_sk = ss_qual.ss_customer_sk
JOIN web_or_catalog_qualified wc_qual ON c.c_customer_sk = wc_qual.customer_sk
WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (6, 7)
GROUP BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  cd_credit_rating,
  cd_dep_count,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  cd_credit_rating,
  cd_dep_count,
  cd_dep_employed_count,

    INNER JOIN date_dim d1 ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk

  WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 13
  LIMIT 1
),
date_range AS (

),
filtered_item_web AS (

),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM (
    SELECT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id, 'store' AS channel

    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN filtered_item fi ON cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    UNION ALL
    SELECT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id, 'web' AS channel
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN filtered_item_web fi ON ws.ws_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98

  GROUP BY fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id

  SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk

  JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_moy = 6 AND d_year = 2002

  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 70 AND 100

  SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk

  JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category = 'Electronics' AND i_class = 'portable'
  JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_moy = 6 AND d_year = 2002

  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 70 AND 100

),
my_revenue AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM my_customers
  JOIN customer_address ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk

WITH cs_ui AS (
  SELECT cs_item_sk,
         SUM(cs_ext_list_price) AS sale,
         SUM(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit) AS refund
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk 
                      AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY cs_item_sk
  HAVING SUM(cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * SUM(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit)
),
cross_sales AS (
  SELECT i_product_name AS product_name,
         i_item_sk AS item_sk,
         s_store_name AS store_name,
         s_zip AS store_zip,
         ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
         ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
         ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
         ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
         ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
         ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
         ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
         ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
         d1.d_year AS syear,
         d2.d_year AS fsyear,
         d3.d_year AS s2year,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         SUM(ss.ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
         SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS s2,
         SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_ticket_number, ss_store_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_cdemo_sk, ss_hdemo_sk, ss_addr_sk, ss_promo_sk, ss_wholesale_cost, ss_list_price, ss_coupon_amt, ss_sold_date_sk
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100

  JOIN store_returns ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk 
                    AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
  JOIN cs_ui ON ss.ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_store_name, s_zip
    FROM store
  ) s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'Y' AND p_channel_tv = 'Y' AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
  ) p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 1 AND 11
  ) i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim d2 ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  JOIN date_dim d3 ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'D') AND cd_education_status IN ('College', '4 yr Degree')
  ) cd1 ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk

WITH filtered_date AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-08-11' AS DATE) AND CAST('2001-08-11' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_category
  FROM item
  WHERE i_current_price > 50
    AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports')
),
filtered_promotion AS (
  SELECT p_promo_sk
  FROM promotion
  WHERE p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND p_channel_tv = 'N'
    AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_press = 'N'
    AND p_channel_event = 'Y'
),
ssr AS (
  SELECT s_store_id AS store_id,
         SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM store_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns ON (ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number)
  INNER JOIN filtered_date ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_promotion ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  GROUP BY s_store_id
),
csr AS (
  SELECT cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id,
         SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM catalog_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number)
  INNER JOIN filtered_date ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN catalog_page ON cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_promotion ON cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
  SELECT web_site_id,
         SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM web_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns ON (ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number)
  INNER JOIN filtered_date ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN web_site ON ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_promotion ON ws_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  GROUP BY web_site_id
)

       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
  SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
         'store' || store_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  FROM ssr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
         'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  FROM csr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
         'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id

  SELECT 'store channel' as channel, 'store' || s_store_id as id,

  LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns ON (ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number)

  GROUP BY s_store_id

  SELECT 'catalog channel' as channel, 'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id as id,

  GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id

  SELECT 'web channel' as channel, 'web_site' || web_site_id as id,
